desc: Ideate approaches and select Fenwick sliding median + DP.
Implement sliding-window median cost calculator for all length-x subarrays using coordinate compression and Fenwick trees for counts and sums.
Derive and implement the cost formula for making a window equal using the lower median, left count/sum, and right count/sum.
Implement DP table or rolling arrays where dp[t][i] is the minimum cost to choose t non-overlapping valid windows within the first i elements.
Define the DP transition carefully: skip position i, or take the window ending at i using cost[i-x] plus dp[t-1][i-x].
Handle boundary conditions, invalid states, large integer answers, and examples with negative numbers.
Run sample tests and edge cases; if failures occur, adjust the implementation or switch to a different approach.
